sidebar.accessDeniedTitle: You don't have access to Settings
sidebar.accessDeniedDescription: Ask an administrator to grant the required permission.

blueprints.title: Blueprints
blueprints.subtitle: Set the steps a department's tickets follow, who runs each step and what it asks for.
blueprints.noDepartmentHint: Saved before blueprints had departments. It governs no ticket until you choose one.
blueprints.emptyBody: A blueprint sets the steps a ticket goes through, who may move it and what each step asks for.
blueprints.noDepartments: Add a department before you create a blueprint.
blueprints.noAccess: You don't have access to Blueprints
blueprints.noAccessBody: Ask an admin for the "Manage blueprints" permission.
blueprints.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? It moves to the Recycle Bin.
blueprints.orderHint: A ticket enters the first matching blueprint in this order.
blueprints.addStateBody: Adds a value to the ticket Status field and places it on the canvas.
blueprints.addStatePartial: Saved part of the state. Try again to finish.
blueprints.closedHint: A Closed state ends the blueprint. You can change that on the state later.
blueprints.openHint: Open and On Hold states keep the ticket in the blueprint.
blueprints.name: Name
blueprints.criteriaHint: Only tickets that match these conditions enter this blueprint.
blueprints.continuousHint: In a continuous Blueprint, the next transition is automatically triggered as soon as the current transition is completed. This type of Blueprint is best-suited for building scripts for call agents.
blueprints.transitionOwnersHint: Choose the agents and teams, or the ticket owner, who can run every transition that names no owner of its own.
blueprints.otherDepartmentOwners: Transition Owner from a Different Department
blueprints.otherDepartmentOwnersHint: Add one from the same menu. Agents from other departments can also run these transitions, and Desk shares the ticket with their department while this blueprint governs it.
blueprints.transitionOwnersSummary_one: {{count}} owner for transitions without their own
blueprints.transitionOwnersSummary_other: {{count}} owners for transitions without their own
blueprints.strictModeHint: Restrict agents from editing fields, sending replies, leaving comments, asking approvals, adding resolutions, and uploading attachments outside of Blueprint transitions.

strictScope.allHint: Agents can do none of these actions on a ticket in this blueprint, except through a transition.
strictScope.specifiedHint: Agents cannot do the actions you tick, except through a transition. Everything else stays open.
strictScope.allExceptHint: Agents can do only the actions you tick on their own. Everything else needs a transition.

blueprints.strictFieldsHintSpecified: Leave all unticked to restrict every field.
blueprints.strictFieldsHintAllExcept: Leave all unticked to leave every field free.
blueprints.strictNeedsAction: Tick at least one action. The blueprint cannot be saved without one.
blueprints.dynamicOwnersHint: Allows support administrators to assign transition owners within a record dynamically. They can assign transition owners from the current department or share the record with other departments for their agents to complete the transition.
blueprints.selectHint: Select a state or a transition on the canvas to edit it.
blueprints.dragHere: Drag a state here to start
blueprints.emptyCanvas: Drag a status from the list onto the canvas, or use Add State to create one.
blueprints.phoneDrawNote: Draw states and connectors on a larger screen. You can edit settings here.

issue.blueprintOwnerNoMembers: Each department owner under Transition Owners needs an agent or a team
issue.blueprintOwnerNoMembersOff: Each department owner under Transition Owners needs an agent or a team. Turn on the continuous switch to edit it
issue.targetFieldRequired: Choose the field the blueprint governs
issue.statesRequired: Place at least one state on the canvas
issue.preExpiryTooLarge: {{state}}: the warning must come before the time limit, and the time limit must be set
issue.stateNotAllowed: {{state}} is no longer a ticket status

unnamedTransition.fromTo: The transition from {{from}} to {{to}} needs a name
unnamedTransition.to: The transition to {{to}} needs a name
unnamedTransition.from: The transition from {{from}} needs a name

unnamedSubTransition.fromTo: A parallel step of the transition from {{from}} to {{to}} needs a name
unnamedSubTransition.to: A parallel step of the transition to {{to}} needs a name
unnamedSubTransition.from: A parallel step of the transition from {{from}} needs a name
unnamedSubTransition.id: A parallel step of transition {{transition}} needs a name

issue.oneSubTransition: {{transition}} needs at least two parallel steps, or none
issue.subTransitionIdRequired: A parallel step of {{transition}} needs an id
issue.groupWithForkJoin: {{transition}} cannot have parallel steps and branches at once
issue.unknownSource: {{transition}} starts from a state that is not on the canvas
issue.unknownTarget: {{transition}} leads to a state that is not on the canvas
issue.unknownForkTarget: {{transition}} branches to {{state}}, which is not on the canvas
issue.unknownJoinSource: {{transition}} joins from {{state}}, which is not on the canvas
issue.unreachable: {{state}} cannot be reached from the start
issue.autoNoTransition: {{state}} moves tickets when the time limit runs out, but no transition is chosen
issue.autoMissingTransition: {{state}} runs a transition on its own that no longer exists
issue.autoParallelGroup: {{transition}} has parallel steps, so it cannot run on its own
issue.autoNeedsWait: {{state}} must wait at least 1 minute before it runs a transition on its own
issue.autoMandatory: {{transition}} asks for items the agent must fill in, so it cannot run on its own
issue.triggerNotCandidate: {{state}}: "{{field}}" names {{transition}}, which does not start from this state
issue.replyOnExitState: {{state}}: "{{field}}" is set, but a customer reply cannot move a ticket out of an exit state
issue.triggerParallelGroup: {{state}}: "{{field}}" names {{transition}}, which has parallel steps and cannot run on its own
issue.triggerMissingTransition: {{state}}: "{{field}}" names a transition that no longer exists
issue.approvalTooManyApprovers: {{transition}}: Submit for approval names more than {{max}} default approvers
issue.fieldValidationIncomplete: {{transition}}: a check on {{field}} needs a condition and a message

errors.connectionLimit: A state can have up to 16 connections.
errors.stateOccupied_one: {{count}} ticket is in {{state}}. Revoke it before removing the state.
errors.stateOccupied_other: {{count}} tickets are in {{state}}. Revoke them before removing it.

editor.beforeHint: Who can run it and when it shows
editor.autoReply: Runs on its own when the customer replies. Nobody runs it by hand.
editor.autoRating: Runs on its own when the customer rates. Nobody runs it by hand.
editor.autoTimer: Runs on its own when the time limit runs out. Nobody runs it by hand.
editor.anyAgent: Any agent in the department who can edit the ticket
editor.shareNote: While the ticket is in {{state}}, Desk shares it with {{department}} at {{access}}.
editor.shareNoteBlueprint: While this blueprint governs the ticket, Desk shares it with {{department}} at {{access}}.
editor.departmentMembers: Add a team or agent of {{department}}
editor.noDepartmentMembers: Pick the teams or agents of {{department}} who run it.
editor.criteriaShowHint: The button shows only on tickets that match.
editor.itemsOrder: The agent sees these in this order.
editor.noItems: Nothing to fill in, so the agent runs it in one click. Add an item to ask for a reply, a field or a check.

itemHint.approval: Asks agents to approve the ticket
itemHint.share: Shares the ticket with another department

editor.fieldChecksHint: The transition cannot run until the field passes each check. The agent sees your message.
editor.fieldCheckIncomplete: Set a condition and a message.
editor.fieldCheckComplex: This check has several conditions, which are kept. Only its message can be edited here.
editor.actionsHint: Run in this order once the ticket moves.
editor.noFreeAddress: Recipients are people in Desk. Free addresses are not offered.
editor.noCustomActions: Workflow has no active custom action for Desk that you may run.
editor.workflowNote: Runs in Workflow once, with the ticket as context.

customActionReason.recordBound: it runs only on a list of records
customActionReason.other: it cannot run from a blueprint

readOnly.reply: {{owner}} has Read only access and cannot send the required reply.
readOnly.resolution: {{owner}} has Read only access and cannot set the required resolution.
readOnly.approval: {{owner}} has Read only access and cannot submit the required approval request.

restricted.reply: {{owner}} has Restricted access and cannot send the required reply.
restricted.resolution: {{owner}} has Restricted access and cannot set the required resolution.
restricted.approval: {{owner}} has Restricted access and cannot submit the required approval request.

triggerRefused.reply: {{transition}} asks the agent for a reply, so it cannot run on its own.
triggerRefused.items: {{transition}} asks the agent to fill in required items, so it cannot run on its own.

editor.exitHint: A ticket that reaches this state leaves the blueprint.
editor.example: A ticket that enters on {{start}} gets the warning on {{warn}} and is due on {{due}}.
editor.exampleNoWarning: A ticket that enters on {{start}} is due on {{due}}.
editor.exampleWeek: Counted on a sample Monday to Friday, 9 to 5 week.
editor.exampleHours: Counted on the default business hours, {{name}}.
editor.exampleDefaultHours: Counted on the default business hours.
editor.warnTooLate: The warning must come before the time limit.
editor.autoMoveHint: Runs this transition on its own after the wait, with or without a time limit.
editor.ratingAnyHint: None ticked, so any rating runs it.
editor.transitionOrderHint: A ticket in this state shows its transitions in this order.
editor.transitionOrderCommonHint: A common transition shows on every state, so moving it here moves it on every state.
editor.reopenHint: Nothing set, so a customer reply reopens the ticket as it does today.
editor.defaultApproversHint: The agent running the transition can change them. Up to {{max}}.
editor.requiredForSome: Required for some agents and teams
editor.requiredForHint: Required for these agents and members of these teams. Optional for everyone else.
editor.requiredForNobody: Pick at least one agent or team, or the blueprint cannot be published.
editor.defaultShareHint: The agent running the transition can change it and add more departments.
editor.businessHoursSetDefault: The ticket's SLA hours, else the default hours
editor.businessHoursSetGone: Deleted business hours (the default hours count)
editor.exampleChosenGone: The chosen business hours were deleted, so the default business hours count, {{name}}.

levels.title: Escalation levels
levels.hint: Each level emails and notifies its recipients before, at or after the time limit. Only people who can see the ticket are told.
levels.max: A state can have at most {{count}} escalation levels.

problem.offset: Enter an offset of at least a minute.
problem.beforeLimit: A level before the limit must come after the ticket enters the state. Use an offset shorter than the limit.
problem.offsetMax: The offset can be at most 365 days.
problem.limit: Set a time limit: a level counts from it.
problem.template: This email template was deleted. Choose another one.

blueprints.includeBody: The tickets you pick enter {{name}} at the state you choose. History names you.
blueprints.includeNeedsState: Choose the state the tickets enter at.
blueprints.revokeBody: Every ticket in progress in {{name}} leaves it and keeps its status. Its timers stop and Status is editable again.
blueprints.shareSkipNote: Tickets you see only through a share are skipped and listed.
blueprints.inProgressUnknown: Tickets in progress not counted yet
blueprints.revokedUnknown_one: {{count}} more ticket may have been revoked. Its result did not come back.
blueprints.revokedUnknown_other: {{count}} more tickets may have been revoked. Their result did not come back.
blueprints.includedUnknown_one: {{count}} more ticket may have been included. Its result did not come back.
blueprints.includedUnknown_other: {{count}} more tickets may have been included. Their result did not come back.
blueprints.stopped: It stopped before the end. Run it again to finish the rest.

skipReason.TICKET_SHARE_ACCESS_DENIED: You see it only through a share
skipReason.NOT_FOUND: Not found, or you cannot see it
skipReason.FAILED: Could not be changed. Try again.

errors.BLUEPRINT_IN_PROGRESS_one: {{count}} ticket is in progress in {{name}}. Revoke it before deleting the blueprint.
errors.BLUEPRINT_IN_PROGRESS_other: {{count}} tickets are in progress in {{name}}. Revoke them before deleting it.
